source_refs.note: ProductKBCandidate PKB-CTX-20260915-01-global-option, kb_version 2-CTX-20260915-01, 32 kb_candidates, 4 conflicts, gate PASS

observations: First-ever Regression Checklist for object 'global-option', feature FEAT-01-global-option-instance-management. Built strictly from the round-2 feature profile and its upstream KB — no new exploration performed.

This feature has NO buyer-facing storefront surface of its own (CRUD of Global Option instances is portal/API only) — round-2 storefront evidence (KB-026..032) belongs to the sibling feature FEAT-02-artwork-personalization-global-option-link and is NOT re-cited here as this feature's own coverage, per the profile's own gate condition.
KB-013/KB-014 remain INFERRED per upstream gate condition — checks tracing to them are forced to oracle_strength=NONE/status=NEEDS_CONFIRMATION here, not upgraded to BASELINE/STRONG.

KB-009 and KB-016 are unassigned_kb_items in the upstream profile (not forced into any capability). KB-009 is represented here only as a STATE_DATA observational check about the row-icon UI difference, explicitly flagged NEEDS_CONFIRMATION and NOT framed as a tested capability of this feature — respects the profile's gate condition not to force it into a capability.
CFL-02 (Category default value) is UNRESOLVED upstream — the one check touching it (CHK-01-012) is marked NEEDS_CONFIRMATION rather than asserting either side as correct.

0 negative/error samples exist for 6 of 7 CRUD operations tested this round; only 1 LOW-confidence sample (Text to Image Save-before-service-selected) and 1 console-warning defect-observation (Word Search) are available — NEGATIVE dimension is therefore only partially covered, rest excluded with reason (see excluded_dimensions).

No semantic duplicate check conditions were found between this checklist and the sibling FEAT-02 checklist during authoring; the closest conceptually-related pair (this file's CHK-01-013 on the 'Update campaign' row-icon UI state vs. FEAT-02's linking-mechanism checks) test different observation points (UI icon rendering vs. layer payload fields) and were kept as separate, non-duplicate checks.

Self-check performed per gate rule 'Dedupe theo ngữ nghĩa. Tạo case trùng để tăng số lượng = gate FAIL': all 19 checks below were reviewed pairwise for semantic overlap; CHK-01-009 (CORE, list/refresh call itself) and CHK-01-011 (STATE_DATA, hard-reload persistence after CRUD) were deliberately kept distinct — one verifies the getData call renders current data, the other verifies server-side persistence survives a hard reload rather than relying on client-side optimistic state.
unknowns: Whether the 23/30 untested leaf types and 6/7 untested-for-edit/clone/delete fixtures behave identically to the tested ones — no check below claims this; each CRUD check's scope is explicitly limited to the types/operations actually observed.
